kind: C5 frozen mechanical competition contract v1
source_precedence: Dated 2026-27 league announcements/current 2026 Cup rules over stale generic FAQ. Sources browsed; direct HTML retention returned HTTP403; normalized rules below and source URLs retained, no bypass.
canonical_events: Provider IDs once; generated season-specific stage/slot IDs. Cup group/QF/SF and filler count in regular82; final, play-in and playoff do not. Actual assigned fixtures replace stage slots, never append. Unknown or inconsistent calendar fails closed.
cup: Six verified 5-team groups/60 unique games. Group wins then tied-team H2H, regulation differential, regulation points, prior regular-season record, seeded drawing. Wildcard only second place, omit H2H. Seed group winners 1-3, wildcard4. QF1v4/2v3 Dec4-5 higher home; SF Dec8-9 higher home; neutral final Dec11 Hinkle.

calendar_assumptions.filler: 22 nonqualifiers: two cross-conference games involving distinct bottom finishers (two per conference); remaining20 intraconference. Each team degree2, no repeated opponent within filler, one home/one away; prefer existing three-game pairings. Deterministic minimum-cost feasible degree2 matching; not official unpublished travel/draw algorithm. Two disjoint slates Dec6 and Dec10, with up to one game on Dec7/9 as required by odd pairing. QF losers pair within conference Dec7/10, correct hosts assumed from current home deficit. No collisions with retained calendar.
calendar_assumptions.travel: Use retained team arena lat/lon if available; otherwise no invented travel metric, disclose omitted travel constraint. Bottom cross pairs fixed by conference rank; frozen alternative swaps cross pair assignment and reverses filler home orientation. Sensitivity reported descriptively, no parameter selection.
calendar_assumptions.postseason_dates: Actual dates replace slots; absent detailed schedule uses ordered round/day slots, 2-day game spacing, global round barrier; no rest/travel effects in accepted pathway. This chronology is an explicit modelling assumption, not an official release.

score_semantics: Retain pathway-v1 regulation bivariate mean/SD/rho, start uncertainty/gain unchanged. Keep existing tied-regulation winner probability. Separate deterministic auxiliary RNG samples nonnegative 5-minute bivariate OT scores conditional on that winner, repeated tied OTs; final=regulation+OT. No clamping. Label synthetic OT/postseason uncalibrated; Cup tiebreaks regulation only. Saved possession games retain exact real per-world periods.
standings: Official recursive two/multiway criteria, division winners first and only for division result; eligible includes tied10th; h2h/division/conference/eligible records from canonical regular events, full final-score differential; seeded draw last. Finals home advantage uses better record then H2H then conference record then draw, verify primary rule before release.
pathway: World-local ratings update chronologically after all modelled games (including Cup final/postseason), regulation surprises only as accepted; no rating/calibration tuning. Active-world masks prevent eliminated-team games/RNG results from entering paths.
evidence: Independent event-ledger recomputation of82/team,1230regular,67Cup events including60shared,oneCupchamp,6playin,16playoffteams,15series,oneNBAchamp; correct hosts/no after-elimination; exact weighted probabilities/conditional support; source cutoff injections; worker/resume identities where used. Compare frozen filler alternative without choosing a winner.
limits: No historical postseason calibration claim. Preserve legacy season path behavior for historical backtests. New provider/source requires owner signoff. Unsupported calendar retains scheduled-only output with competition unavailable and is not scope completion.
first_commands: Inspect current source/retained calendar, validate prior 82-game wins excluding known 2025 Cup final, implement/test mechanics before fresh integrated nightly.
